profile.description: Host-scoped all-on Arm v2 policy for GCP c4a-highcpu-32 / Neoverse-V2 with the 0.6B model. C16 is preferred; C20 is the measured soft edge. This is not a generic Arm or 1.7B profile.

quality_gate.command: strict profile preflight + same-model serving-generation structural/audio gate
quality_gate.audio_gate: same 0.6B model, voice, language, seed/settings and bank; valid non-empty PCM/WAV plus playback checks

parity.notes: Host-scoped c4a-highcpu-32 policy. KAI, RES1_V2, BF16 pre-up, elastic lane split and the 2-slot multislot cohort are pinned active for the measured 0.6B setup; C16 is preferred and C20 is the soft edge.

hardware.smt_policy: OFF; one thread per physical core
hardware.notes: GCP c4a-highcpu-32, no SMT. SVE/SVE2 are present but the engine uses the measured KAI/ASIMD paths here.

server.worker_affinity: contiguous core slices, worker 0 -> CPU 0-7, worker 1 -> CPU 8-15, worker 2 -> CPU 16-23, worker 3 -> CPU 24-31

precision.activations: KAI native preparation; INT8 RES1_V2 decoder panels

QWEN_ARM_BFDOT.why: keep the measured/default KAI BF16 policy explicit; BFDOT is a separate opt-in

OPENBLAS_THREAD_TIMEOUT.why: keep the external BLAS pool from spinning against the engine pool

OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.why: must be absent so engine-owned BLAS sizing is effective

OMP_NUM_THREADS.why: must be absent; the engine profile owns the CPU budget

QWEN_CP_PREFILL2.why: pin the explicit Arm CP prefill policy

QWEN_DECODER_BATCH.why: keep server batching semantics; preflight verifies per-item decoder leaf

QWEN_SD_BF16_PREUP.why: host-scoped all-on 0.6B policy; KAI BF16 prepared-state path is enabled

QWEN_INT8_SDOT_MM.why: do not opt into the separate generic SDOT matmat gate

QWEN_INT8_SDOT_MIN_B.why: pin the Arm SDOT matmat gate even though the product decoder is per-item

QWEN_BFMMLA_MIN_B.why: pin the Arm BF16 matrix gate

QWEN_KAI_LHS.why: pin the existing asymmetric KAI LHS quantisation mode

QWEN_KAI_NCHUNK.why: pin the measured KAI GEMM n-subtiling policy

QWEN_NO_BFMMLA.why: allow native Arm BF16 matrix path

QWEN_NO_KLEIDI.why: KleidiAI is the Arm product backend

QWEN_NO_Q8REPACK.why: retain the native Arm Q8 repack path

QWEN_NO_SDOT.why: require the Arm DOTPROD decoder leaf

QWEN_POOL_SPIN.why: Arm-specific starting policy; must be requalified on the target host

QWEN_PREFIX_CACHE.why: same server semantics as the AMX lane

QWEN_SD_AMX.why: x86-only legacy switch; must be absent on Arm

QWEN_SD_INT8.why: select the measured Arm INT8 RES1_V2 decoder

QWEN_SD_INT8_BLK.why: pin the existing non-VNNI decoder block policy

QWEN_SD_LANE_SPLIT.why: reserve the measured Arm decoder lane split

QWEN_SD_MULTISLOT.why: measured 2-slot shared-weight cohort for this host/model policy

QWEN_SD_RES1_V2.why: select the verified rectangular/wide Arm DOTPROD decoder leaf

QWEN_SD_RAG_MIN_PANELS.why: same logical threshold; no Arm ragged decoder implementation is implied

QWEN_SD_STREAM_STRIP.why: Design-D warm strip unavailable on Arm

QWEN_SD_WINDOWED.why: explicitly disable the legacy windowed fallback so the exact streaming decoder semantics are resolved

QWEN_SERVER_NO_DECODER_BATCH.why: presence flag must remain absent; decoder request is explicit

QWEN_TTS_STREAM_LAYOUT.why: same official known-text serving layout as AMX; ICL/clone and live incremental text remain outside this lane

qualification.workload: Host-scoped 0.6B all-on deployment candidate on GCP c4a-highcpu-32, 4x8. C16 preferred; C20 is the soft realtime edge; C32 is admission-only.
qualification.speaker: ryan
qualification.notes: This profile deliberately scopes the all-on deployment candidate to this 32-core c4a host and the 0.6B model. It makes no 1.7B claim and does not change arm-product defaults. Final confirmation: C16 had zero errors/rejects/timeouts and STREAM_RTF p95 0.881 but missed per-class drift; C20 is an edge with STREAM_RTF p50/p95 1.02/1.09 and playback degradation; paired audio mel correlation was 0.94558-0.96306 vs 0.98. C32 must remain admission-only. Status stays unqualified until the numerical/audio delta is fixed or explicitly accepted.
